faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.bestModel.q: What is the best AI model?
faq.bestModel.a: Based on our transparent scoring, {name} currently leads with an overall score of {score} out of 100. Scores combine public benchmarks, capability, price efficiency, and context window, and are updated daily.
faq.howRanked.a: Models are scored on a transparent 0-100 formula: public benchmarks (50%), capabilities (20%), price efficiency (20%), and context window (10%). Rankings are snapshotted daily; the full methodology is documented on the ranking page.
faq.priceUpdate.a: Prices are sourced from official provider pricing and refreshed on a regular schedule, with price history tracked per model. The last update date is shown on each model page.
faq.benchmarkSource.q: Where does benchmark data come from?
faq.benchmarkSource.a: Benchmark results come from public sources (e.g. MMLU, GPQA, HumanEval, AIME) with dataset, version, and test date attributed on each entry. Note that some entries are community-submitted and unverified, as marked.
faq.modelContext.a: {name} supports a context window of {context} tokens.
faq.modelCost.a: {name} costs ${in} per 1M input tokens and ${out} per 1M output tokens.
faq.compareBetter.a: Based on overall scores, {winner} ranks higher ({sa} vs {sb}). See the comparison table for a full breakdown.
faq.compareCheaper.a: {cheaper} is cheaper: ${pa} vs ${pb} per 1M input tokens.
faq.compareCapability.q: What are the capability differences between {a} and {b}?
faq.compareBetter.aNone: No overall ranking data is available for {a} and {b}.
faq.compareCheaper.aNone: Price data is not available for {a} or {b}.
faq.compareCapability.aNone: {a} and {b} support the same set of capabilities.
landing.empty: No models available for this category yet.
landing.faq.bestFor.q: What is the best model for {case}?
landing.faq.bestFor.a: Based on our data, {name} ranks first for {case} with a score of {score}.
landing.faq.howSelected.a: Models are ranked by scenario-specific data: benchmark scores (coding/reasoning/math/vision), capability support, context window, or price. All data comes from our transparent model catalog, updated daily.
landing.faq.dataFresh.a: Model data, prices, and rankings are refreshed on a regular schedule; ranking scores are snapshotted daily. Each model page shows its last verified date.
